title: Market Analytics
description: Price history, regional spread, forecasts and supply signals for every tracked product — computed from platform offers.
askQuestion: Analyze the {{product}} wholesale market: prices, regional differences, forecast and supply.

picker.label: Select product
picker.more: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} — type to narrow down

history.title: Price history
history.description: Daily average with min–max band, last {{days}} days
history.method: Daily average of each active offer's latest price

forecast.title: 7-day forecast
forecast.caveat: A forecast is an estimate based on past prices, not a guarantee.

sd.title: Supply & demand
sd.description: What the platform observes vs what we estimate from it
